name: Maria Dornauer
beschreibung: Hotel Maria Dornauer is located in the Scheibe district of Neustift im Stubaital. The quiet valley location is equally suited to active holidaymakers and those seeking relaxation. The style of the house is traditional and is shaped by its family-run management. The hotel's wellness area includes an indoor pool, saunas and relaxation areas. The accommodation is geared towards the needs of couples and families. Meals are offered as half board, which includes a breakfast buffet and an evening choice menu. One focus of the cuisine is on regional Tiroler cuisine.
